name: zmodel_fog_set_density
description: zModel fog density setter stores the supplied float density directly.
known_limits: Tier C only; no reviewed VC COFF byte comparison has been accepted, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4762a0 validates loading the float argument from [esp+4], storing it directly to gModel_FogDensity, and returning with ret 4.
Native smoke zmodel_fog_set_density_smoke verifies positive fractional and negative density values are stored exactly.
